results.evidence_text: N-6 fatty acids were not associated significantly with breast, colon or prostate cancer.
results.manual_review_reason: Abstract frames linoleic acid status as the exposure but reports the prostate-cancer result only for adipose n-6 fatty acids as a group; cannot determine from title/abstract/MeSH whether a linoleic-acid-specific prostate estimate exists or is inseparable from the n-6 mixture.
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract states linoleic acid status was the primary exposure yet reports the prostate-cancer association only for grouped n-6 fatty acids, so whether the target is separable (INCLUDE) or compound (S2-COMPOUND) cannot be resolved from allowed evidence.
